rules.rationale: This is the terminating case of the lpfSpec mathematical recurrence: once F squared exceeds N, the summary is defined to return N.
This equation defines the divisible branch of lpfSpec by removing one factor F and recursively summarizing the quotient.
This equation defines the nondivisible branch of lpfSpec by advancing the candidate factor and recurring.
